button.name: action_open_enrolment
button.help: Students of the eligible groups see it on the portal and enrol between the dates of the enrolment period.

button.name: action_close_enrolment
button.confirm: The ranking data are frozen now and nobody else can enrol. Continue?
button.help: EMS closes it by itself when the enrolment period ends.

button.name: action_submit_proposal
button.string: Send the proposal to the coordinator

button.name: action_publish_provisional
button.confirm: The provisional list is published on the portal and each student receives their provisional result by email, to claim until the claims deadline. Continue?
button.help: Set the claims deadline in the Selection tab first.

button.name: action_approve_selection
button.confirm: The definitive list is published, each student receives their own result and the participants' files open. Continue?

button.name: action_draw_ties
button.invisible: not needs_draw or state not in ('selection', 'validation')
button.confirm: EMS orders each tie at random and records the result. It cannot be repeated. Continue?

button.name: action_return_proposal
button.help: Write why in the Selection tab first.

button.name: action_export_participants
button.help: The selected students and the accompanying teachers, in the same spreadsheet format as the calls.

button.name: action_export_dossier
button.help: The group's common documents and every participant's record as a ZIP, in the record's categories, with an index of what is missing and the files' hashes.

button.name: action_propose_substitution
button.invisible: not next_reserve or user_role not in ('team', 'leader')

button.name: action_sync_requirements
button.help: Adds to every file the documents asked for that it does not have yet.

button.name: action_end_stay
button.help: The return documents and the EU Survey start.

button.name: action_propose_closure
button.invisible: state != 'return' or closure_proposed_date or user_role not in ('team', 'leader')

button.name: action_cancel
button.help: Write the reason in the Closure tab first.

sheet.div: There is a tie in the ranking: the Erasmus coordinator resolves it with a draw (Actions, Draw the ties).

eligible students have no evaluated module, so they have no record average: the Erasmus team enters it by hand with its reason, or the coordinator excludes them with a reason (Selection tab). The ranking cannot be closed until then.
selected students have not accepted the commitment letter on the portal yet (they or, for a minor, their family).
A place is free: the next reserve is .

field.name: return_note
field.invisible: state not in ('selection', 'validation') or (not return_note and state == 'selection')

button.name: action_request_exception
button.title: Ask the coordinator for the exception written in Exception requested

button.name: action_open_renounce
button.title: Record that the student renounces the place or the reserve place, with the reason
button.invisible: state != 'enrolled' or result not in ('selected', 'reserve') or parent.state not in ('preparation', 'stay')

button.name: action_mark_needs_change
button.invisible: review_state == 'needs_change' or (handled_by == 'team' and not signers) or parent.user_role not in ('team', 'leader')

button.name: action_open_signatures
button.invisible: not signers or parent.user_role not in ('team', 'leader')

button.name: action_send_to_sign
button.invisible: not can_send_to_sign and sign_state not in ('1_draft', '0_sent')

button.name: action_remove_file
button.invisible: review_state == 'valid' or not attachment_ids or parent.user_role not in ('team', 'leader')

field.name: sign_template_id
field.invisible: not (sign_participant or sign_guardian or sign_director or sign_coordinator or sign_tutor or sign_host)

field.name: description
field.placeholder: What happened, who was told, what was decided...

button.name: action_send_to_sign
button.invisible: not can_send_to_sign and sign_state not in ('1_draft', '0_sent')

page.name: commitment
page.div: Accepted provisionally: the destination or the dates are still to be confirmed. Once they are, the student (and the family of a minor) accept the letter again.

form.p: A selected student frees their place for the next reserve; a reserve leaves the reserve list, so the next one can be proposed. The enrolment and the file are kept.

field.name: reason
field.placeholder: e.g. The family told the leader teacher they cannot travel
